notes.title: New release: Sunsets 2 DLC - Free puzzle inside!
notes.notes:
Hello, puzzle enthusiasts!

We’re delighted to announce Sunsets 2, the latest DLC for Super Jigsaw Puzzle: Generations! 

This stunning second installment brings you 30 breathtaking puzzles capturing the beauty of sunsets across forests, seas, mountains, snowy landscapes, crop fields, and more! There’s nothing quite like a sunset to evoke peace, wonder, and inspiration!

And as always, we’re giving away a free puzzle from this collection to all players! Add Sunsets 2 to your puzzle collection and enjoy the magic of sunsets piece by piece today!

Keep relaxing and do puzzles!

notes.title: New DLC release: Random 7 and a free puzzle!
notes.notes:
Hi folks!

Get ready to dive into the unexpected with Random 7, our newest DLC!

This unique collection brings you 30 diverse puzzles, featuring everything from stunning landscapes and amazing animals to classic cars, ships, delicious foods, vibrant fruits, and more! There’s a little something for everyone!

Explore the variety in Random 7 and add some excitement to your puzzle library today!

And as a special treat, we're giving away a free puzzle from this collection to all players!

notes.title: New DLC release with a free puzzle: Flowers 2!
notes.notes:
Hi friends!

The Flowers 2 DLC has just arrived, the second in our blooming series for Super Jigsaw Puzzle: Generations!

Immerse yourself in 30 stunning puzzles that capture the delicate beauty and vibrant colors of nature’s most enchanting flowers! From lush garden blooms to wildflower meadows, each puzzle is a celebration of nature's artistry!

Plus, to share the joy of these floral wonders, we're giving away a free puzzle from this collection to all players!

Add these breathtaking flowers to your puzzle library and savor the beauty of every petal!

notes.title: Winter 2021 DLC, free puzzle and a BIG UPDATE!
notes.notes:
Hello guys!

We are going to present you the new DLC in a moment, but first we have to talk you about a huge update we made to the game!

So, we added a new COINS STORE! Where you can expend your coins for free puzzles! And you have 30 puzzles to choose! We are going to add more in the future, too!

Now with the DLC: Winter 2021 is here! With 17 pictures of snowy places that wants you to turn on the heat and enjoy doing them! And with a 20% discount!

And last but not least, a free puzzle!

Thanks for playing and if you like it, please support us!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34702962/2394edc35f35092fac21a615771adf6581562bc7.jpg

Keep relaxing and do puzzles!
